title: Affine model pointing compatibility
statement: Given the hypotheses, a local pointed etale triple t, a global pointed etale triple c, a map i : c.B → t.B, and the structure equation c.α ≫ i = algebraMap(R, Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) ≫ t.α, the descended map preserves the residue-field pointing equation.

proof.text: Residue-field compatibility from the structure equation establishes the pointing equality.

mathlib_searches.query: affine etale model descending from localization at a prime

mathlib_searches.results: Generic localization extensionality only; does not construct the required pointed etale model or cocone leg.

mathlib_searches.query: etale finite presentation descent localization component extension
mathlib_searches.results: No existing declaration in Mathlib, WeilConjectures, or Sheaf supplies this statement.
